mentions.name: tinyLIRPA
mentions.description: This library implements the ⍺β-CROWN algorithm for neural network verification on top of the tinygrad deep-learning framework, whose small set of operations and laziness made the implementation straightforward. Neural network verification is framed as currently being more of a research interest than something practical.
mentions.source_excerpt: I implemented an algorithm for neural network verification called ⍺β-CROWN for a deep-learning library called tinygrad.
